title: KHR_character_skeleton_mapping Role Association Properties
description: Associates a role from an external skeletal vocabulary with a glTF node. The node index is authoritative; the optional name belongs to the association.

node.description: Index of the associated glTF node in the top-level nodes array.
node.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the top-level `nodes` array. The referenced node is not required to be a member of any `skin.joints` array.

name.gltf_detailedDescription: This name is independent of the referenced node's name. Resolution MUST use `node`, not `name`.
